prompt: A new Redis Cloud database is created without anyone touching the data eviction policy setting. Which policy is in effect?
explanation: volatile-lru is the default data eviction policy on Redis Cloud databases: it removes the least recently used keys among those that have an expire field set. allkeys-lru evicts across every key regardless of TTL, noeviction makes writes fail once the limit is reached instead of removing anything, and volatile-ttl evicts the keys with the shortest remaining TTL, so those are all deliberate changes rather than the out-of-the-box setting.
